name: Stat row
summary: Three figures with labels in a ruled row, plus a source line underneath. Stacks on phones.
accessibility: Figures are a description list: each label is a <dt> and each value a <dd>, so they are read as pairs.
The visual order puts the value first with flex-col-reverse, while the source order keeps the label first for screen readers.
